html: Scavenger receptors do more than take particles up. CD36 and LOX-1 bound to oxidised lipids or particles recruit Src-family kinases (FYN, LYN, YES1, SRC), which activate the tyrosine kinase SYK and the adaptor LAT, and these switch on PI3K; SRC also activates RAS. LOX-1 activates the small GTPase RAC1, which assembles the phagocyte NADPH oxidase NOX2, the source of superoxide and hydrogen peroxide in macrophages.
